text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E after a 16.7% gain felt satisfying, but I should judge a sale by the stock’s prospects and my portfolio needs, not just by locking in a gain.","My account grew while I held through several periods, reminding me that patience can be worthwhile; I should avoid trading just because prices move.","I should keep risk and diversification in mind, and make deliberate choices that fit my long-term goals rather than reacting to short-term changes."]}
